description: This Java source file defines the RegistrationClientImpl class, which implements a client for Hono's Device Registration API using Vertx and Proton. It includes methods for creating clients, constructing request addresses, handling registration assertions, and managing response caching.

classes.name: RegistrationClientImpl
classes.description: A Vertx-Proton based client for Hono's Registration API, handling registration assertions and response caching.

methods.name: getTargetAddress
methods.description: Constructs the AMQP target address for a given tenant ID.

methods.name: createMessageId
methods.description: Generates a unique message ID for registration requests.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Processes the response from the registration service into a RegistrationResult object.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new RegistrationClient for a tenant, with optional caching and link creation.

methods.name: createDeviceIdProperties
methods.description: Creates a map of properties including the device ID for registration requests.

methods.name: assertRegistration
methods.description: Performs device registration assertion, with overloads for including gateway ID and parent span context.
